title: Home
text:
LinkedIn  GitHub  ORCID





Ph.D. student in Electrical Engineering at the University of New Mexico researching radiation-induced effects in wide bandgap optoelectronics. I work across III-V MOCVD growth, device design/fabrication, and electro-optical characterization. I also use Python to automate tasks across these areas, including instrument control and data analysis.
I like salsa/bachata dancing and long walks with my dog!
